attackers_goals: Use an account that was possibly compromised in the past to gain access to the network and access privileged resources.
description: A machine account successfully logged in to a VPN service.
investigative_actions: See whether the service login was successful. Check whether the account has done any administrative actions it should not usually do. Look for more logins and authentications by the account throughout the network.
name: VPN login with a machine account
